limits: All scores are from saved 240-path, inner-2, seed-start-0 outputs; no forecasts or fits were run.
Each screen is a selected 29-request development cohort. Conditional equal-bucket values use only observed request support under frozen full-panel V9 weights.
The diverse24 group has all three calendar buckets; incident5 contains only long-bucket requests and has no equal-three-bucket headline.
The screens are separate matched cohorts and are not comparable to the 17,395 representative-mass estimate or full 320,017-request headline.
CDF candidates are compared with their matched empirical parent arm and fixed WR; ratio_partition is compared with current, mapped_ratio and fixed WR.
scope: Compact aggregate-only publication; full per-request diagnostic output retained privately. Diverse24 is predeclared primary; incident5 long-only stays separate. No full-panel candidate promotion.
